BNP PARIBAS GLOBAL SECURITIES OPERATIONS, Chennai 
Position: Assistant Manager 
Duration: Nov 2017 - Nov 2025 
 
 
Job Responsibilites 
 
• SWIFT feed analysis and issue handling: Work with custodian in case of any issue with related to SWIFT (MT940/950, MT535). Handle 
the missing balances in the unknown swift and liaise with custodian to get the required swift feed and perform the reconciliation 
• PROD readiness of new fund: Ensure to keep the Intellimatch Setup ready for any new account prior to Go-live date and engage with 
custody to get the MT940/950 & MT535 swifts to ensure smooth Go-live 
• Transition & Deployment: Actively involving in deployment activities for new Business requirement and perform static setup in 
Intellimatch, analysis feeds integration & fund closures, STIF inputs etc. 

• Client Handling: Participate in daily & weekly calls with client & oversight representatives, handling escalations and resolving aged 
exceptions. 
• FA Admin: Handling fund static setup for new fund launch and Manual statement position posting in Winigate application based on 
custody statement position 
• Research and coding outstanding breaks: Perform research for high aged breaks; ensure coding & commenting as per clients. Regular 
follow-up with internal team & custodian to clear long O/s. 
• SOP review & sign off: Ensure SOP documents are reviewed internally on periodic basis and it is shared and approved by client on 
quarterly/Monthly basis. 
• Team handling & Work allocation: Managing a team of 8 members and ensure client deliverables are met within deadline without 
compromising quality. 
• Other activities: Leave management, identifying training requirement, resource allocation, Issue tracker, Error tracker, Over 3 days 
ticket management and Monthly dash board (MIS Report). 
• Manage the Change management (BA’s) to understand the Business requirement and provide/Prepare BRD for the development team 
to Automate. 
• Data analysis and data validation/gathering from each level to understand the business actuals and the change expected. 
• Act as an intermediate between the Tech team and the user until the Automation moves to live in Production 
• Perform regression testing, Unit/UAT testing and confirm the changes are appropriate. 
• Design the error and defect log between the requirement and the development and close the gaps during UAT testing 
• Co-ordinate with users/prod support and suggest them the better and simplest way of developing the reconciliation thereby reducing the 
risk. 
• Documentation of the problem statement and detailed remediation approach with steps to be followed 
• Missing Balances: Ensure the missing balances received due to incorrect swift feeds are cleared on the same day. Liaise with custody 
and get the necessary transactions are uploaded in TLM. 
• Security Linking: Analyze recon exceptions which not match-off due non-linking of security id or custodian is using the dummy security. 
Identify the breaks and work with oversight to link the dummy with market known identifiers
